item_changes.comment: Move RC-005 from hard_dependencies to explanatory_dependencies. The spectral expansion requires RC-003 and RC-004, but the normalised update is application context rather than a mathematical prerequisite. Add an explicit repeated-matrix-product fallback and revise the rationale.

Add orthogonality-and-projection as an external prerequisite. The fallback omits the full spectral derivation but still relies on understanding a non-zero projection onto v_1. Update the rationale to distinguish minimal projection knowledge from the full RC-003 theorem.

Remove iterative-algorithms-and-stopping from external prerequisites. RC-011 itself introduces the iteration, tolerance, residual stopping rule, and maximum-iteration fallback, so the proposed bridge duplicates Contract content.

Remove iterative-algorithms-and-stopping. RC-011 already provides the algorithm and stopping semantics as an implementation dependency. Retain NumPy operations and vector norms as genuine external prerequisites.

Move RC-004 from hard_dependencies to explanatory_dependencies. The example-specific dominant eigenvalue can be identified by a short local magnitude comparison. Extend the fallback and rationale accordingly.

concept_changes.comment: Add RC-007 to supports_item_ids. Narrow the bridge to inner products, orthogonality, and scalar projection coefficients; exclude the spectral theorem and eigenbasis expansion because those belong to RC-003 and RC-006.
Change need_type from recommended to required conditional on RC-002 being selected. Revise the rationale so that pathway-level optionality is not confused with prerequisite strength within RC-002.

Remove this external prerequisite concept. Its content is already represented by RC-011 and reached by RC-017 through an implementation dependency. If a separate programming prerequisite is later needed, define a narrowly scoped basic-python-control-flow concept rather than duplicating algorithmic Contract content.

revision_scope.overall_comment: Revision required for RC-006, RC-007, RC-011, RC-017, and RC-018. Revise the orthogonality/projection and determinant prerequisite concepts, and remove the iterative-algorithms-and-stopping concept because it duplicates RC-011.
